overview.text: Soil_1_48 is a hybrid polyketide, terpene-precursor, NRPS-like, nonribosomal peptide and class II lanthipeptide cluster detected by antiSMASH, DeepBGC and GECCO.
It spans 272 kb on contig_1 and contains 107 genes.

genes.text: antiSMASH marks 35 genes as biosynthetic, including 15 core and 20 additional genes, alongside 12 regulatory and 9 transport genes.
Seven core genes are named by at least one of the three detection tools.
CJLEIP_06060 encodes a dimethylallyltransferase and is classed as a core terpene-precursor gene by antiSMASH.
CJLEIP_06067 is a type I polyketide synthase with six modules, five predicted to load malonyl-CoA and one with no substrate.
CJLEIP_06073 is a type I polyketide synthase with three modules, all predicted to load malonyl-CoA.
CJLEIP_06077 is a type I polyketide synthase with one module predicted to load malonyl-CoA.
CJLEIP_06079 is a type I polyketide synthase with one module predicted to load malonyl-CoA.
CJLEIP_06081 is a type I polyketide synthase with three modules, all predicted to load methylmalonyl-CoA.

Together these 15 CAL, NRPS and PKS genes hold 36 modules in all; antiSMASH predicts a substrate for 27 modules, including malonyl-CoA for 21, methylmalonyl-CoA for three, threonine for one, proline for one and glycine for one, while two modules have no substrate and seven lack an adenylation or acyltransferase domain.

Additional biosynthetic genes include a cytochrome P450 (CJLEIP_06099), a glycosyltransferase (CJLEIP_06101), a thioesterase domain-containing protein (CJLEIP_06158), a 4-hydroxybenzoyl-CoA thioesterase (CJLEIP_06167) and a short-chain dehydrogenase (CJLEIP_06058).

similar.text: The closest MIBiG entry is BGC0000034 (candicidin) from Streptomyces sp. FR-008, and this is a close match.
Twenty-three genes of the locus have counterparts in BGC0000034 at 98 to 100 percent identity, and antiSMASH finds counterparts for 100 percent of that cluster's genes.
Core genes CJLEIP_06067, CJLEIP_06073, CJLEIP_06077, CJLEIP_06079 and CJLEIP_06081 match FscD, FscE, FscE, FscF and FscB of the candicidin cluster at 98 to 99 percent identity.

hypothesis.text: Given the strong similarity to the candicidin cluster and the presence of multiple type I PKS modules loading malonyl-CoA and methylmalonyl-CoA, this cluster may produce a polyene macrolide antifungal similar to candicidin; the additional cytochrome P450, glycosyltransferase and thioesterase genes could further modify the macrocycle, while the dimethylallyltransferase and lanthipeptide genes suggest possible hybrid or additional peptide-polyketide products.

facts.sentence: Soil_1_48 is a polyketide, terpene-precursor, NRPS-like, nonribosomal peptide (NRPS) and class II lanthipeptide cluster, found by antiSMASH, DeepBGC and GECCO (all three detection tools).
It spans 272 kb on contig_1 (6,762,952–7,035,108) and contains 107 genes.
antiSMASH marks 35 genes as biosynthetic (15 core and 20 additional), 12 as regulatory and 9 as transport.
7 core genes are named in the locus, each by at least one of the three detection tools, antiSMASH, DeepBGC and GECCO.
CJLEIP_06060, annotated by Bakta as Dimethylallyltransferase, is named as a core gene by antiSMASH; antiSMASH classes it as a core terpene-precursor gene.

CJLEIP_06067, annotated by Bakta as sulfolipid-1 biosynthesis phthioceranic/hydroxyphthioceranic acid synthase, is named as a core gene by antiSMASH, DeepBGC and GECCO; antiSMASH classes it as a core T1PKS gene; antiSMASH finds 6 modules in it, and predicts malonyl-CoA for 5 and no substrate for 1 for its acyltransferase domains.

CJLEIP_06073, annotated by Bakta as sulfolipid-1 biosynthesis phthioceranic/hydroxyphthioceranic acid synthase, is named as a core gene by antiSMASH, DeepBGC and GECCO; antiSMASH classes it as a core T1PKS gene; antiSMASH finds 3 modules in it, and predicts malonyl-CoA for all 3 for its acyltransferase domains.

CJLEIP_06077, annotated by Bakta as SDR family NAD(P)-dependent oxidoreductase, is named as a core gene by antiSMASH, DeepBGC and GECCO; antiSMASH classes it as a core T1PKS gene; antiSMASH finds 1 module in it, and predicts malonyl-CoA for its acyltransferase domain.

CJLEIP_06079, annotated by Bakta as Polyketide synthase, is named as a core gene by antiSMASH, DeepBGC and GECCO; antiSMASH classes it as a core T1PKS gene; antiSMASH finds 1 module in it, and predicts malonyl-CoA for its acyltransferase domain.

CJLEIP_06081, annotated by Bakta as sulfolipid-1 biosynthesis phthioceranic/hydroxyphthioceranic acid synthase, is named as a core gene by antiSMASH, DeepBGC and GECCO; antiSMASH classes it as a core T1PKS gene; antiSMASH finds 3 modules in it, and predicts methylmalonyl-CoA for all 3 for its acyltransferase domains.

Together these 15 CAL, NRPS and PKS genes with modules (CJLEIP_06067, CJLEIP_06073, CJLEIP_06077, CJLEIP_06079, CJLEIP_06081, CJLEIP_06084, CJLEIP_06087, CJLEIP_06094, CJLEIP_06125, CJLEIP_06126, CJLEIP_06130, CJLEIP_06151, CJLEIP_06152, CJLEIP_06153 and CJLEIP_06155) hold 36 modules in all; antiSMASH predicts a substrate for 27 modules (malonyl-CoA for 21, methylmalonyl-CoA for 3, threonine for 1, proline for 1 and glycine for 1) and none for 2 modules; 7 modules have no adenylation or acyltransferase domain.
CJLEIP_06099 encodes Cytochrome P450 and is marked by antiSMASH as an additional biosynthetic gene.
CJLEIP_06101 encodes Glycosyltransferase and is marked by antiSMASH as an additional biosynthetic gene.
CJLEIP_06158 encodes Thioesterase domain-containing protein and is marked by antiSMASH as an additional biosynthetic gene.
CJLEIP_06167 encodes 4-hydroxybenzoyl-CoA thioesterase and is marked by antiSMASH as an additional biosynthetic gene.
CJLEIP_06058 encodes Short-chain dehydrogenase and is marked by antiSMASH as an additional biosynthetic gene.
